digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify workflow and external integration testing
propositions: Gerrit Verify currently runs thousands of real Pandoc subprocess conversions over the complete DC wiki corpus, consuming 184+ seconds of critical path time on macOS.
ADR 0095 requires every conversion assertion to use the real Pandoc binary; a narrower superseding ADR is needed to move complete corpus replay to external integration tests.

The approved design preserves three representative live corpus bodies and compact probes in Gerrit Verify while moving full real-Pandoc replay to a dedicated weekly/manual job in external-integration.yml.
The external-integration workflow is currently Ubuntu-only and requires a future pandoc-corpus-replay matrix job with ubuntu-latest and macos-latest arms.

Every existing assertion class must remain required against committed deterministic outputs in Gerrit Verify; all production renderer invariants, platform boundaries, and safety assertions are preserved.
Version drift and platform-specific Pandoc binary fingerprints must fail fast, with deterministic fixture regeneration remaining available and paired A/B implementation evidence required.
